Pong! I can’t ping external hosts from here, but I can help you ping from your device or explain latency checks.

Quick ways to ping from your system:
- Windows (Command Prompt):
  - ping google.com
  - Optional: ping google.com -n 5 (send 5 pings)

- macOS/Linux (Terminal):
  - ping google.com
  - Optional: ping -c 5 google.com (send 5 pings)

If you want to ping a specific IP:
- ping 8.8.8.8 (Windows/macOS/Linux)

Need help with interpreting the results or want a one-liner for a quick check?
